title: West Pakistan Goats Restriction Sindh Repeal Act 1972

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Goats Restriction Sindh Repeal Act 1972
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XVIII OF 1972
ACT XVIII OF 1972
WEST PAKISTAN GOATS (RESTRICTION) (SIND
REPEAL) ACT, 1972
An
act to repeal the West Pakistan Goats (Restriction) Ordinance, 1959, as
applicable to Sind
[Gazette of Sind, Extraordinary, 28th
December 1972]
(First
published after having received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the
Gazette of Sind (Extraordinary), dated the 28th December, 1972).
1. Short title and commencement.--(1)
This Act may be called the West Pakistan Goats (Restriction) (Sind Repeal) Act,
1972.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Goats Restriction Sindh Repeal Act 1972
sections.description:
Repeal

ACT XVIII OF 1972
ACT XVIII OF 1972
WEST PAKISTAN GOATS (RESTRICTION) (SIND
REPEAL) ACT, 1972
An
act to repeal the West Pakistan Goats (Restriction) Ordinance, 1959, as
applicable to Sind
[Gazette of Sind, Extraordinary, 28th
December 1972]
(First
published after having received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the
Gazette of Sind (Extraordinary), dated the 28th December, 1972).
2. Repeal.--The West Pakistan Goats (Restriction) Ordinance, 1959
(West Pakistan Ordinance XLII of 1959), as applicable to Sind, is hereby
repealed.
